correctness.rationale: For nonzero t=Q(z) the fixed polar constraint leaves the orthogonal complement, with quadratic level −Δ/(4t) and determinant class det Q/t; in the odd-dimensional Gaussian count the two t factors cancel modulo squares and the sign becomes εχ(Δ). At a nonzero isotropic z, a hyperbolic partner with pairing 1/2 gives Q(uz+vh+y)=uv+Q(y) and v=i−j. Thus i≠j determines u for each y, giving L; i=j uses the nonzero level of the complementary even form with the retained determinant sign ε, giving L−B. The zero-dimensional quotient has zero nonzero-level count, as required in the split plane. The origin count is 2U. On t≠0, the individual two same-shell character sums are −1 and the mixed discriminant sum is −2 (its t=0 term is 1), so ΣH=−6. In H², the squares contribute 6q−12−4χ(ab), the same-shell cross-term contributes −2−2χ(ab), and the others contribute 4(T_a+T_b). Exact multiplicities 1,Z−1,U then give the stated energy, with q⁻ᵈ required for the unnormalized Fourier transform. Interchanging b and t gives the unrestricted T_a total 1 by the nonzero quadratic discriminant 16at for t≠0; the exclusions b=0,a contribute −1−χ(−3), q−2. Fourth-power rescaling of t exchanges T_b with T_a at a²/b. The two rational infinities of each smooth monic quartic account for τ=−1−T. The only allowed collision is at b=9a for T_a (and a=9b for T_b); there the factors are t(t−4a)²(t−16a) and the excluded root gives T_a=−1−χ(−3). In characteristic 3 the singular ratio is excluded, and in characteristic 5 the two singular ratios coincide without invalidating either correction. The q-independent assertion applies to the centered trace sum, not the raw T sum, whose linear term is explicit in (40). The analytic proof, not the finite checks, covers arbitrary dimensions and field degrees.
